consequence.statement: Purely additive: an environment that sets webhook.extraEnv gets the custom environment variables applied to the webhook Pod as documented, and an environment that does not set it is unaffected; nothing fails and no operator action is required.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds a new Helm value `webhook.extraEnv` that allows setting custom environment variables in the webhook Pod (the same release note / PR #7317 also adds the analogous values `cainjector.extraEnv` and `startupapicheck.extraEnv`, which are separate subjects of the same addition).
